objective: First visit to the Parallel World. A small early automation becomes visible there as a modest glowing structure. Establish the core visual rule: real-world systems generate parallel-world architecture.

metadata.call_to_action: Cada sistema real construye un mundo.

captions.es: El primer sistema, apenas una chispa.
captions.en: The first system, barely a spark.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: A small glowing structure rising in the Parallel World, The Traveler and NØVA watching it form

notes: Theme: small, unglamorous beginnings are still real beginnings.
Emotional conflict: wanting the first system to feel bigger than it is.
Visual motif: first full reveal of the Parallel World — establish its geometric-city aesthetic here.
NØVA asks "¿Eso es Opsly?" — The Traveler answers "No. Pero creo que es una pieza."
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 03.
